g.text: Elasticsearch plays a crucial role in the food delivery system design,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: primarily serving as a powerful search and analytics engine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for restaurants, menu items, and related information.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Purpose of Elasticsearch in the Food Delivery System:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Fast and Efficient Searching: Elasticsearch enables quick and relevant

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: search results for users looking for restaurants, cuisines, or specific dishes.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Real-time Updates: It allows for near real-time updates of restaurant

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: information, menus, and prices, ensuring customers always see the most current data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Complex Querying: Elasticsearch supports complex queries, including geospatial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: searches, which are crucial for finding nearby restaurants or determining delivery areas.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Scalability: It can handle large volumes of data and high concurrent searches, which

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is essential for a food delivery platform with millions of users and restaurants.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Faceted Search: Elasticsearch facilitates faceted search, allowing users to filter

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: results by cuisine type, price range, ratings, etc.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Fuzzy Matching: It can handle typos and provide relevant results even when search

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Elasticsearch plays a crucial role in the food delivery system design,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: primarily serving as a powerful search and analytics engine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Its purpose is to provide fast, scalable, and efficient search

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: capabilities for restaurants, menu items, and related information.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: The Real-Time Tracking DB stores dynamic, unstructured data such as the GPS coordinates

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: of delivery drivers. Since driver locations change frequently, a NoSQL database is preferred

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: over traditional relational databases because it can handle high-frequency updates, offers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: flexibility with unstructured data, and is highly scalable for large datasets.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Popular NoSQL Databases in the Market:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Redis: An in-memory key-value store often used as a cache, but it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: can also manage real-time tracking if combined with geospatial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: extensions like RedisGeo, which supports storing and querying location-based data.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * MongoDB: A widely-used document-based NoSQL database, offering

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: excellent support for geospatial queries, which are essential for tracking locations.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Cassandra: A highly scalable NoSQL database, optimized for write-heavy

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: workloads and capable of handling massive amounts of data. Ideal for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: real-time tracking in large systems like Uber Eats.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * Firebase Realtime Database: A NoSQL cloud database offered by Google, designed

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: for real-time data syncing, commonly used for tracking locations in mobile applications.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * DynamoDB (AWS): [Expensive] A fully managed NoSQL database that offers high performance

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and scales automatically. Its integration with AWS services makes it a great

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: choice for large-scale real-time tracking systems.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
